user.title: Configure Mattermost
user.description: Set up Mattermost notifications using a bot token. You'll need to create a bot account in your Mattermost server first.

data_description.url: URL of your Mattermost server, including port if needed (e.g., chat.company.com or 192.168.1.100:8065).
data_description.api_key: Bot access token generated from your Mattermost bot account. This is NOT the Token ID.
data_description.default_channel: Default channel name for notifications (e.g., general, alerts).

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Mattermost
reconfigure.description: Update the connection settings for this Mattermost server.

data_description.url: URL of your Mattermost server, including port if needed (e.g., chat.company.com or 192.168.1.100:8065).
data_description.api_key: Bot access token generated from your Mattermost bot account. This is NOT the Token ID.
data_description.default_channel: Default channel name for notifications (e.g., general, alerts).

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Mattermost server
error.invalid_auth: Invalid bot token or authentication failed
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred during setup

abort.already_configured: This Mattermost server is already configured

init.title: Mattermost options
init.description: Optionally bridge this Mattermost bot to Home Assistant's Assist feature, so you can chat with Home Assistant via Mattermost direct messages or @mentions.

data_description.enable_assist_bridge: When enabled, anyone who can send this bot a Mattermost direct message, or @mention it in a channel it belongs to, can issue Home Assistant voice/chat commands. Only enable this if you trust everyone with access to this bot.
data_description.assist_agent_id: Optional: the specific Assist conversation agent to use. Leave blank to use the default agent.

send_message.name: Send Mattermost message
send_message.description: Send a message (text, attachments, and/or file) to one or more Mattermost channels via a specific configured server.

config_entry_id.name: Mattermost server
config_entry_id.description: Which configured Mattermost server to send through. Required if more than one is configured.

message.name: Message
message.description: The message text to send (can be empty if using attachments).

target.name: Channel
target.description: Channel name, display name, or channel ID. Can be a single channel or list of channels. Defaults to the server's configured default channel if omitted.

file.name: File
file.description: A local file path or remote URL to upload alongside the message.

attachments.name: Attachments
attachments.description: A list of Mattermost rich message attachments.

deprecated_notify_service.title: The Mattermost notify service is deprecated
deprecated_notify_service.description: notify.mattermost will be removed in a future release. Please switch to the Mattermost notify entity or the mattermost.send_message service.
